mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an easing monetary policy, which reduces the discount rate for equity valuations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined over the prior month, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5% for three consecutive months, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that increases equity discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods where FEDFUNDS > 4.5% for 3 months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the unemployment rate and increase in nonfarm payrolls signals strong labor market conditions that boost corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods where UNRATE declines and PAYEMS increases, or the interaction term in a regression model has a negative coefficient with p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle economic expansions, a rising unemployment rate signals weakening labor demand and potential earnings contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of late-cycle periods with rising UNRATE, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential construction permits, as measured by HOUST, indicates strong housing market activity that boosts consumer confidence and corporate investment, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods where HOUST has increased for two consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When residential construction permits (HOUST) fall below 1400 thousand units for two consecutive months, it signals a housing market slowdown that reduces consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods where HOUST < 1400 for 2 months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust manufacturing activity that supports corporate profit growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods where INDPRO has increased for the past three months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100 for two consecutive months, it signals a manufacturing slowdown that reduces corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods where INDPRO < 100 for 2 months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
